title: 12th November - Padho Bharat
summary: As part of Diwali cleaning, 1,500 books were collected from neighbourhoods, carefully sorted and handed over to the main branch of Anjuman-I-Islam for distribution across 50 Anjuman-I-Islam schools in Mumbai.
description:
As part of Diwali cleaning, 1,500 books were collected from neighbourhoods, carefully sorted and handed over to the main branch of Anjuman-I-Islam for distribution across 50 Anjuman-I-Islam schools in Mumbai.
An initiative by Rtn. Rabia Patel, turning the spirit of giving into the gift of knowledge.
Beneficiaries 1000 plus
Project cost Nil
